title: Linux updates — feedback after Launch installer

steps.path: Version chip → Launch installer → password prompt
steps.headline: The panel tells you it is waiting for administrator approval.
steps.changed: Launching becomes Waiting for administrator approval, with an activity indicator.
steps.notice: The panel explains the password prompt and automatic restart.
steps.risk: Preview uses scripted output; no privileged installation was run.

steps.headline: You can see what the installer is doing after entering your password.
steps.changed: Recent installer output replaces Launching. Reopening keeps the active installation.
steps.notice: Package checks and post-install hooks appear as the installer reports them.
steps.risk: Only the latest 8 KB is shown; no estimated percentage.

steps.headline: An installation failure keeps the actual explanation under Details.
steps.changed: Errors stay inside Details, alongside report and manual-finish options.
steps.notice: The real error stays available instead of disappearing.
steps.risk: This database-lock error is a scripted example, not your diagnosis.

steps.path: Version chip → Launch installer → unconfirmed result
steps.headline: An uncertain result warns you instead of inviting a second installation.
steps.changed: An unconfirmed result shows a warning, not another install button.
steps.notice: Report or diagnose it without starting a second installer.
steps.risk: The installer keeps running; its eventual result updates the panel.

steps.headline: A successful installation says Restarting YouCoded before the app closes.
steps.changed: A confirmed Linux installation shows Restarting YouCoded before closing.
steps.notice: The app closing is an expected restart.
steps.risk: Preview pauses here; the app normally closes shortly afterward.
